name: hanyuguide
description: Study your HanyuGuide flashcards in the chat, quiz yourself on HSK vocabulary, look up Chinese words, convert pinyin, and organize your study lists.

interface.longDescription: Sign in with a HanyuGuide account to study your HanyuGuide flashcards right in the chat: your due reviews and new words from your lists appear as cards, and each answer is saved to the same review schedule as the HanyuGuide app. Get quizzed on random words from any HSK 2.0 or HSK 3.0 level, look up Chinese words, convert text to tone-mark pinyin, and inspect character stroke data, with definitions in your language. The assistant can read your study context and personal lists, and ask HanyuGuide to add a word the dictionary is missing. With separate permissions, save your study answers, add words in bulk, move or remove words, and create, rename, reorder, archive, or restore personal lists. These tools cannot change preferences or billing.
defaultPrompt: Let's do my HanyuGuide reviews here.
Look up 学习 and explain its meaning.
